direcaoDoUsuario: Um pouco mais sombrio, com cabelos longos e silhueta esguia.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE approval-preview NEUTRAL portrait of the new "Herdeiro do Culto" for an existing medieval narrative RPG. The three supplied portraits are STYLE, PALETTE and BUST-PROPORTION references only. Create a new original male character, not a copy of any of their faces.

Subject: an adult man with a notably slender, elongated silhouette, narrow shoulders, a slim neck, a long angular face and high cheekbones. Long straight hair parted near the center falls beyond his shoulders in a few broad flowing strands. Clean-shaven, normal human ears. He is reserved and a little more somber than the other heirs: calm watchful dark eyes under understated brows, a slender straight nose and a thin neutral closed mouth, with only a hint of a knowing expression. Keep him human and subtly charismatic; not sickly, skeletal, elderly, monstrous or aggressively snarling. Do not copy the tired crowned character's face.

Outfit: a simple dark charcoal medieval robe/tunic, fitted to the narrow silhouette, with a modest narrow raised collar and a small warm-white inner collar edge. A few clean long fabric folds and one small aged-gold clasp at the upper chest. No hood obscuring his long hair. This is the neutral initial appearance, before active cult adherence: no large cult flame, red ceremonial mantle, skulls, runes, magical effects, armor, weapons or crown. Let the long hair, dark clothing and reserved expression convey the somber character.

Mandatory style: he must look drawn by the same artist as the three existing heirs. Thick irregular black ink outlines, simplified expressive facial forms, subtly caricatured proportions, economical hand hatching and flat color. Use the SAME warm near-white approximately #F9EEDD for skin, light hair strands and light cloth details as the reference heirs; never gray skin, realistic flesh color, pure white or the darker yellow-beige event-card tone. Hair may have broad dark ink masses with clear warm-white ribbon highlights matching their graphic hair treatment. Keep dark shapes readable on a black interface with restrained light contour accents. The one clasp may use small muted aged gold. No extra colors or bright red.

Composition: centered bust only, all head and long hair, neck, narrow shoulders and upper chest, gentle three-quarter angle. Keep the head large and readable like the reference heirs while making the torso visibly esguio/slender. Entire silhouette contained inside a square canvas with clean margins and a smooth curved bottom cutout. No hands or lower body.

Output one PNG-style illustration, preferably 1024x1024, with genuinely fully TRANSPARENT alpha outside the figure. Preserve fine paper grain inside the figure only. No background, parchment sheet, halo, drop shadow, scenery, circle, decorative frame, text, logo or watermark. No realism, painterly rendering, anime, 3D, modern goth clothing, eyeliner-heavy makeup, vampire fangs or childish cartoon. Keep the illustration simple and alive, within the established heir cast.
